# Pre-identity generated dependencies

Bindings for `fleet.common` from `../rev_a/configuration.brd`, generated by
`quarry-schema-compiler 0.1.278 (3d61834)`, the last compiler before generated
configuration identity (#99). Tests copy each file to its name without the
`.pre_identity` suffix and check that bindings from the current compiler that
depend on it fail with the "predates configuration identity" diagnostic.

The suffix keeps formatting hooks from rewriting genuine generator output. Do
not regenerate these files with a newer compiler.
